title: Slow down · phrase / phrasal verb
subtitle: 「減速／放慢步調／放緩進度」，究竟是哪一種 slow down？
description: 「減速／放慢步調／放緩進度」，究竟是哪一種 slow down？

words.note: 使用者提供。reduce speed 是 slow down 最直接、中性的正式改寫，特別適合 vehicles, machines, traffic, procedures。它明確聚焦速度下降，而不是一般活動量或節奏放慢。
words.example: Drivers should reduce speed near the school entrance.

exercises.original: Drivers must slow down before entering the tunnel.
exercises.zh: 駕駛者進入隧道前必須減速。
exercises.upgrade: reduce speed · 降低速度；減速

options.explanation: drivers + before entering the tunnel makes literal vehicle speed the decisive clue.
技術性動詞，表示 velocity 降低，常見於運輸、工程、科學。 本題的決定性線索是 a deliberate reduction in vehicle speed；這裡需要的是「直接降低物理／機械速度」。因此 decelerate 雖與 slow down 有重疊，但究竟是精確速度、活動節奏、技術減速、進程變慢、逐步收力或口語勸告並不最吻合。

words.meaning: 放慢一點；別那麼急；以較慢節奏進行
words.note: 較口語。take it slower 表示有意把做事、走路、訓練或生活節奏放慢，常帶 advice / self-management 色彩。它比 ease the pace 更 conversational。
words.example: You've been working nonstop; try to take it slower this weekend.

falseSynonyms.zh: reduce speed 專注物理或機械速度；slow down 還可指工作、增長、程序或生活節奏。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Drivers should reduce speed near the school. Economic growth may slow down.

falseSynonyms.zh: decelerate 是技術性 movement/velocity 詞；一般工作節奏或談話節奏通常不用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The aircraft decelerated after landing. We need to slow down the rollout.

falseSynonyms.zh: ease the pace 強調活動節奏變輕鬆；車輪、列車等精確速度較適合 reduce speed/decelerate。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The team eased the pace after the deadline changed. The train slowed down near the station.

falseSynonyms.zh: ease off 常有逐步降低力度／速度／壓力的意味；slow down 可只是結果性變慢。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ease off the accelerator. Traffic slowed down in the rain.

falseSynonyms.zh: stop 是完全停止；slow down 只是速度或進度下降，活動仍然繼續。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The car slowed down. The car stopped.

falseSynonyms.zh: delay 表示使開始／完成時間推遲；slow down 表示進行速度變慢，兩者可導致相似結果但不是同義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The approval process slowed down. The storm delayed the flight.

falseSynonyms.zh: pause 是短暫停止；slow down 不要求停止。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She paused before answering. She slowed down as she approached the corner.

falseSynonyms.zh: slow down 是動詞片語；slowdown 是名詞，表示減速／放緩現象。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Production slowed down. There was a slowdown in production.
